subject: MAP draft: Phoenix Health pilot — updated timeline & split workstreams
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@phoenixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: Phoenix Health pilot - first pass

Hi Ayesha —

Great conversation today — thanks for walking through your pilot objectives and the privacy constraints for inpatient data ingest. Per our call I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached as a simple milestone list) to align on owners, dependencies, and a target window for contractual close. High-level items I captured:

- Pilot scope & success criteria: 3 inpatient sites, inference latency < 200ms P95, and monthly cost targets
- Security and compliance: SOC2 evidence and a short gap assessment; IT will need the SOC2 report and network IP allowlist
- Procurement & contracting: PO + standard MSA + one redline on data retention
- Technical kickoff: sandbox access, sample data handshake, and initial performance benchmarking
- Target close: "end of Q4" (we noted internal approval cycles on your side)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm priority of milestones and any missing stakeholders by EOW 11/05
2) We (Redwood) to provide a clean SOW + estimated uplift pricing for the sandbox work by 11/08
3) Security to drop SOC2 evidence to your team and schedule a short architecture review (Ben)

Attaching: Phoenix_MAP_v1.xlsx (simple milestone table).

If the procurement timing slips on your side we can split the MAP into two parallel workstreams (technical onboarding + procurement/contract) so your engineers can make progress before purchase finalizes. Happy to draft a revised timeline if that helps.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Lead Solutions + Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Phoenix_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@phoenixhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@phoenixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Phoenix Health pilot - first pass

Thanks Monica — helpful recap. Quick update from our side after talking to procurement and IT: procurement is tied up until mid-December due to a vendor consolidation effort and our VP of IT is out for two weeks starting 11/08. That means the PO/MSA path will likely not conclude in Q4.

What we can do:
- Move the commercial close target to end of Q1 2028 (targeting 2028-03-29)
- Prioritize the technical onboarding and sandbox work now (Team will approve access that doesn't require a signed PO) so we can validate performance and build internal champions
- Security team will need the SOC2 report and an architecture summary before sandbox access is provisioned

I'm attaching our procurement_calendar.pdf so you can see the blocking dates.

Could you update the MAP to show the split workstreams you mentioned and a revised milestone schedule? Also please include an interim milestone for the security sync (I'll be the point for scheduling).

— Ayesha
Ayesha Khan
Director, Clinical Systems
Phoenix Health
ayesha.khan@phoenixhealth.com

Attachments: procurement_calendar.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-04T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft - Phoenix Health (procurement shift) — internal only

Ben / Evelyn —

Heads up: Phoenix Health just pushed commercial close to EOY Q1 2028 (target 2028-03-29) because procurement and IT availability are constrained. They still want to proceed with technical onboarding in parallel under an access-safe model.

Ask: can we fast-track SOC2 extracts and a short architecture summary this week? Ben, can you confirm whether we can provide a redacted SOC2 attestation + simple IP allowlist checklist by 11/08? Evelyn, I need a draft of the sandbox SOW + one-off pricing for the initial benchmarking (2 engineer-days + infra credits).

I'll update the MAP to show two parallel workstreams (technical onboarding first, procurement/commercial second) and circulate back to Ayesha. I also want to propose an interim milestone: "Security sync completed" before sandbox access.

Short timeline I plan to push to them:
- 11/05: updated MAP (split workstreams) delivered to Ayesha
- 11/08: SOC2 extracts + sandbox SOW to Phoenix
- 11/15: initial sandbox access and smoke tests

Confirm if this looks feasible.

— Monica

Subject: Re: MAP draft: Phoenix Health pilot — updated timeline & split workstreams

Ayesha —

Thanks for the calendar and the clarity — appreciate the heads up on procurement. I've attached an updated MAP (Phoenix_MAP_v2.xlsx) that splits the plan into two parallel workstreams:

Workstream A — Technical Onboarding (advance now):
- Milestone A1 (11/08): SOC2 extracts + architecture summary delivered (Ben)
- Milestone A2 (11/15): Sandbox access granted, smoke tests by PHX engineers (Evelyn & PHX IT)
- Milestone A3 (11/30): Performance benchmarking and preliminary cost model (Redwood + PHX devs)

Workstream B — Commercial & Procurement (parallel cadence):
- Milestone B1 (target 2028-03-01): Legal review + redline consolidation
- Milestone B2 (target 2028-03-15): PO issuance
- Milestone B3 (target 2028-03-29): Contract signed & commercial close

I've explicitly called out dependencies (procurement freeze, IT approver out, required SOC2 documents) and owners in the spreadsheet. If the timeline for procurement ends up shifting further, we can convert the commercial milestones to tentative dates and proceed with an "engineering-first" trial that phases billing on usage once the PO executes.

Action items for Ayesha: please confirm the priority of the three technical milestones and whether your security team prefers a standalone architecture deck or a short Confluence page. Once you confirm, we'll share the SOC2 extracts and the sandbox SOW (links below).

Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/phx/Map_v2 (MAP v2)
DocuSign (draft SOW): https://app.docusign.com/PHX-4827-SOW

Attachments: Phoenix_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Monica
Monica Patel
Lead Solutions + Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Monica / Ayesha —

This looks good to me. Two small asks from procurement/security before we lock the dates:
1) Can Redwood provide a short redacted SOC2 summary + a one-page data flow diagram for the sandbox (helps our InfoSec triage)
2) A draft SOW we can circulate internally (even if it's not final — DocuSign link would be useful)

If you can deliver those two items by 11/15 we can meet the 11/15 sandbox milestone and keep the commercial milestones on track for Q1 close. Also, happy to set a 30-minute security sync next week to resolve any outstanding questions — Ayesha will coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the engineers into the sandbox.

— Tom Reynolds
